name: OpenWrt Router
summary: Manage an OpenWrt router on your network: internet and LAN, Wi-Fi, devices, port forwards, services, packages, backups, firmware and every UCI setting, with automatic undo if a change cuts you off.

screenshots.alt: The Router page showing its Wi-Fi tab with two radios and their networks, and a bar with two changes waiting to be applied

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Connect to an OpenWrt router on your local network with the account you sign in with
Change router settings you save and apply, start and stop its services and install or remove its packages
Restore a backup, install firmware, restart or reset the router after you confirm
